record.label: Conditional structured fifth-order carrier family
record.summary: Generic TT16 and whole-tensor CP8/16 are terminal at their exact scopes. Only a collision-sidecar residual carrier paired with a materially different covariance-resummed base remains conditional, and it is blocked until the carrier-independent CRX0 theorem solves.
record.terminal_criterion: After B2B2D solves, B2B3C must prove exact G+S seams, source-only rank/action quality, symmetry, and integrated base+carrier cost; otherwise close that residual carrier without overclaiming against all structured tensors.
